name: personal-homepage
title: Personal homepage
description: A personal homepage with a live log: who you are at the top, then a journal your assistant keeps, your projects as cards, your writing, and an About.

images.purpose: the wide photo beside the headline
images.prompt: a wide photograph of the person or their world

images.purpose: the picture when a link is shared; empty uses the hero

content.purpose: the X handle: follow buttons and the byline
one stream with layout feature (the journal your assistant keeps: newest entry in full, with notes) and one with layout list (writing)

art.ask: Ask your person for one wide photo of themselves or their world (their work, their place). A real photo, not a made-up picture.
art.style: Photographs. One wide hero photo; covers for writing entries are optional.
steps: Get the hero photo from your person (photo_upload_link if they send it from their phone).
Check it: wide (about 16:9), at least 2080 px across, sharp; ask for another if not.
Write its alt text with your person: what it shows, in a few words.
Upload it into site.hero, then call theme_needs: the hero should say filled.
